Aladin Lite 3.8.2 — CDS, Strasbourg astronomical data center.
Unmodified ES module distributed from the official npm package aladin-lite.
Source: https://github.com/cds-astro/aladin-lite/tree/3.8.2
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/aladin-lite/-/aladin-lite-3.8.2.tgz

Licence: LGPL-3.0-or-later; accompanying LICENSE, COPYING and COPYING.LESSER retained.
The Aladin logo and link remain visible in the map. The module is dynamically
loaded from this separate, replaceable file; the WebAssembly runtime is embedded.

Reference sky imagery is fetched at runtime from the ESA HiPS mirror:
https://skies.esac.esa.int/DSSColor
Digitized Sky Survey — STScI/NASA; color composition and HiPS by CDS.
DSS copyright and acknowledgments: https://archive.stsci.edu/dss/copyright.html
HiPS metadata: https://skies.esac.esa.int/DSSColor/properties
These reference images are not SPHEREx observations and are not time-synchronous.
